name: std::valarray<T>::resize

declarations.code: void resize(std::size_t count, T value = T());

intro:
Resizes the valarray to contain count elements and assigns value to each element.

This functions invalidates all pointers and references to elements in the array.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
count

 -

 new size of the container


 value

 -

 the value to initialize the new elements with

summary: Resizes the valarray to contain count elements and assigns value to each element.
